name: claude-reel-editor
description: Edit a talking-head reel with Claude Code: cut on true silence, storyboard first, one 3D graphic per line, rendered frame by frame in Chrome.

scripts.setup: npm install && npx puppeteer browsers install chrome
scripts.example:cut: python3 scripts/cut/raw-probe.py example/raw.mp4 && python3 scripts/cut/silences.py example/raw.mp4 example/segs.json --words example/raw-words.json --drop 2 && python3 scripts/cut/join-check.py example/raw.mp4 example/segs.json && python3 scripts/cut/pause-check.py example/raw.mp4 example/segs.json && python3 scripts/cut/make-cut.py example/raw.mp4 example/segs.json example/cut-audio.wav && python3 scripts/cut/retime-words.py example/raw-words.json example/segs.json example/cut-words.json && python3 scripts/cut/words-check.py example/cut-words.json && node scripts/make-data.js example
scripts.export: python3 scripts/music-steady.py example/music.wav && bash scripts/export.sh example/out/reel.mp4 example/music.wav example/out/reel-ig.mp4
scripts.gallery: node scripts/storyboard.js example/gallery && node scripts/check-frames.js example/gallery
scripts.example: npm run example:footage && npm run example:cut && npm run storyboard && npm run check && npm run render && npm run export && npm run qa
